decisions.quote: The Cardiff Model is a promising violence prevention approach that promotes combining injury data from hospitals and LE. The objective was to describe the Cardiff Model implementation and collaboration between hospital and law enforcement partners.
decisions.reason: Although the authors use the public-health term 'replication of the Cardiff Violence Prevention Program' to mean implementing an intervention program in a new setting, the study is a process evaluation of partnership formation, screening tool integration, and nurse workflow in an Atlanta emergency department. Under the codebook, a replication must re-test a specific earlier published finding; this paper does not re-test any published empirical finding on injury reduction or cost-effectiveness.
